subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lullaby
solution:
The correct answer is: Song.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lullaby"** refers to a soothing song or piece of music that is sung to help a baby fall asleep. (लोरी)

 
 
• **Example:** She sang a gentle **lullaby **to her baby every night.
 
 
 
• **"Song"** is a short piece of music with words that are sung. (गाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The **song **she sang was both beautiful and haunting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"Lullaby"** is **"Song"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disturb** (परेशान करना): To interrupt the sleep, relaxation, or privacy of someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Please do not **disturb **the baby while she is sleeping.
 
 
 
• **Baby** (शिशु): A very young child, especially one newly or recently born.
 
 
• **Example:** The **baby **was peacefully sleeping in the crib.
 
 
 
• **Love** (प्यार): An intense feeling of deep affection.
 
 
• **Example:** Their **love **for each other grew stronger every day.

T
